question: The compound interest on a certain sum at 20% p.a. for 2½ years, compounded yearly, is ₹ 2920. Find the principal.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective **Rate of Interest** for the first 2 years = 20 + 20 + (20 × 20)/100 = 44%.

Effective Rate for the remaining 1/2 year = 10%.

Total Effective Rate = 44 + 10 + (44 × 10)/100 = 58.4%.

**Principal** (P) = **Compound Interest** / 58.4% = 2920 / 0.584 = ₹5,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Rate (R) = 20% p.a., Time (n) = 2.5 years, Compound Interest (CI) = ₹2,920.

**Formula:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ¹ × (1 + (R × f)/100), where n1 is the complete years and f is the fraction of the year.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/415d22447e19477b70949c056387601df214d50e379883a2ff0d553e480b1b43.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total **Time** = 2 years + 1/2 year

⇒ Rate for the fractional part = 20% × (1/2) = 10%

⇒ Amount (A) = P × (1 + 20/100) × (1 + 20/100) × (1 + 10/100)

⇒ A = P × (6/5) × (6/5) × (11/10)

⇒ A = P × (396 / 250)

⇒ **Interest** (CI) = A − P = P(396/250 − 1) = P(146 / 250)

⇒ 2920 = P × (146 / 250)

⇒ P = (2920 × 250) / 146

⇒ P = 20 × 250 = ₹5,000

⇒ The **Principal** is ₹5,000, which corresponds to Option (3).

**∴ The correct answer is ₹5,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate for Fractional Time

When time is in fractions like t = n (a/b) years, use the rate R for n years and (a/b)×R for the remaining fraction of the year.

Successive Percentage Formula

For two successive changes of x% and y%, the net effective change is (x + y + (x × y)/100)%.

Compound Interest vs Simple Interest

The difference between CI and SI for 2 years is P(R/100)² and for 3 years is P(R/100)² × (3 + R/100).
